_meta.purpose: Deterministic boundary-recall gold for the WCP leave feature. The measured object is the FEATURE-GRAPH NODE SET (the output of pruneFeatureGraph, before any downstream fallback search), NOT claims. It is the must-pass front for 57B-371 (loosening the prune must recover the T1 misses without dropping the T2 leave core).
_meta.constructionMethod: Three layers, each item carries a provenance note. Sources: (a) commit 443498e honesty-audit + source/graph re-verification of the demo run's FG evidence (250 nodes / 45 files); (b) the deep good report .work/wcp-bf72b0/runs/run-2026_08_10_13_38-f5da2557-4c61c36c-4ab7187e/reports/leave-management-product.md, whose 56 distinct S-* evidence windows were mechanically layered against the demo FG node set into: 11 node-overlap / 32 source-window-only / 4 file-in-FG-but-node-cut / 12 neither (true out-of-bounds); (c) source truth at excavator-test-repos/wcp. Anchor paths are written module-relative (per-module CodeGraph db form, e.g. internal/handlers/...) for Go so the suffix path match against FG's module-prefixed evidence (wcp-service-v2/internal/...) is exercised, and full-prefix for the wcp-service JS module. Anchors use path+name (name === node.name exactly) and NEVER node id (ids carry NUL + a hash and are unstable across db rebuilds); lines-overlap is used only where no single node name applies (T3 windows).

layers.T1: 3 confirmed misses, mustFind, RED today. Present in source + CodeGraph index (with real inbound edges) but absent from the FG node set -> an expand-depth / prune problem, not an index gap. 57B-371 must turn these green.
layers.T2: 10 regression sentinels, mustFind, GREEN today. Derived from the 11 good-report windows that overlap current FG nodes, each mapped to a named node and re-verified against source. Guards against 57B-371 re-ranking pushing today's correctly-captured leave core back out.
layers.T3: 15 optional, informational only (never mustFind, never affects exit code). The 12 'neither' out-of-bounds windows (index-only migration + accrual_test.go + swagger/README dropped as non-substantive) plus the 4 'file-in-FG-but-node-cut' windows plus 2 named leave UI modals. Suspected extra boundary gaps for 57B-371 diagnostics; substantiveness NOT individually adjudicated.

_meta.note: The historical 'Wave0 leave gold (84 items)' referenced in Linear 57B-370 does NOT exist as a data file (recall.mjs and the gold ledger never entered git). This gold is a fresh, reproducible minimal rebuild; its numbers are NOT comparable to the Wave0 44% figure (different gold, different measurement layer: node set vs claim reconciliation).
